title: Unreformed
summary: UNREFORM'ED, adjective 1. Not reformed; not reclaimed from vice; as an unreformed youth. 2. Not amended; not corrected; as unreformed manners; unreformed vices. 3. Not reduced to truth and regularity;

inlines.v: UNREFORM'ED, adjective 1. Not reformed; not reclaimed from vice; as an unreformed youth. 2. Not amended; not corrected; as unreformed manners; unreformed vices. 3. Not reduced to truth and regularity; not freed from error; as an unreformed calendar.
